example: I suggest that we review the grammar exercises before taking the test.

definition: To deactivate or cause a device, light, or engine to stop operating.
example: Remember to turn off all electric appliances before leaving the apartment.

example: Please turn on the desk lamp so we can read the study materials.

definition: A single distinct meaningful element of speech or writing.
example: Look up the unfamiliar word in your learner's dictionary.

definition: A person who has written a particular text, or a person who writes books or stories as an occupation.
example: The acclaimed fiction writer published her third mystery novel this autumn.

definition: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.
example: The young child was afraid of loud thunder during the storm.

example: Researchers were delighted to discover that the rare tortoise was still alive.

definition: Appealing to look at; pleasing in appearance.
example: The modern apartment has an attractive balcony overlooking the garden.

definition: Relating to Austria, its people, or its classical musical heritage.

definition: Able to be used or obtained; at someone's disposal.
example: Freshly baked artisan bread is available every morning at the bakery.

definition: Having fair, golden, or pale yellow hair.

example: The children grew bored while waiting inside during the afternoon downpour.

definition: Not interesting; tedious and unexciting.
example: A repetitive lecture with no examples can feel quite boring.

definition: Giving out or reflecting a lot of light; shining; of vivid color.
example: The living room was warm, welcoming, and delightfully bright with morning sun.
amharic: ብሩህ | አብሪ (በብርሃን የተሞላ፤ ወይም በጣም ብልህ)

definition: Exceptionally clever or talented; outstanding.

example: Be very careful when cutting vegetables with that sharp knife.

example: A careless calculation caused an error in the final engineering report.

definition: Unpleasantly cold; causing shivering.

example: He listens to classical orchestral symphony music while studying.

definition: Having a particular color or different colors rather than black or white.

example: The carnival dancers wore colorful feathered costumes and sparkling beads.
amharic: ቀለማማ | ደማቅ (በብዙ ደማቅ ቀለሞች ያሸበረቀ)

definition: Providing physical ease and relaxation; free from stress.
example: The living room sofa was soft, warm, and remarkably comfortable.

definition: Having as an intended recipient, destination, or purpose.
example: She bought a colorful illustrated storybook for her niece.

example: The bus runs from the airport directly to the city center.

definition: Situated or moving with bounds of an enclosure.
example: Keep the delicate books inside the protective cabinet.

example: The sunlight streamed through the bedroom window.

definition: Up to the point in time or that event mentioned.
example: We waited at the railway platform until the train arrived.

example: Although the climb was steep, they reached the summit safely.

definition: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences.
example: We ordered soup and toasted bread for dinner.
synonyms: plus | along with | as well as
amharic: እና (ሁለት ቃላትን ወይም አረፍተ-ነገሮችን የሚያያይዝ)

definition: Used to indicate that something happens during the time when something else is taking place.
example: She waved to her friends as the train pulled away.

definition: For the reason that; since.

example: If it rains tomorrow, we will study inside the library.

example: He neither complained nor showed any sign of fatigue.

definition: As soon as; when.
example: Once the rain stops, we will resume our soccer game.
synonyms: as soon as | the moment that
amharic: ልክ እንዳደረገ ወዲያውኑ (አንድ ነገር ከተፈጠረ በኋላ ወዲያውኑ)

definition: Used to link alternatives.
example: Would you prefer black coffee or fresh orange juice?

definition: For the reason that; because; from a past time until now.
example: Since the weather is sunny, let us walk through the park.
amharic: ከ... ጀምሮ | ስለሆነ (የጊዜ መነሻን ወይም ምክንያትን አመልካች)

definition: And for this reason; therefore.
example: The rain was heavy, so we decided to stay indoors.

definition: Despite the fact that; although.
example: Though he was exhausted, he completed his homework.

definition: At whatever time; on whatever occasion.
example: Whenever you visit the capital, please come stay with us.
synonyms: at any time that | each time that
amharic: በማንኛውም ጊዜ (አንድ ነገር በተከሰተ ቁጥር)

definition: In contrast or comparison with the fact that.
example: Her brother enjoys mathematics, whereas she prefers literature.
amharic: በተቃራኒው ግን (የሁለት ነገሮችን ልዩነት ለማነጻጸር)

definition: Expressing a doubt or choice between alternatives.
example: He was unsure whether to travel by train or by bus.
amharic: ቢሆንም ባይሆንም (ሁለት አማራጮችን ለማመላከት)

definition: But at the same time; but nevertheless.
example: The morning was cold, yet the winter sky was cloudless.
amharic: ሆኖም ግን | ገና (እስካሁን ያልተፈጸመ፤ ወይም ይሁን እንጂ)
